blindSourceSummaries: A foreign home-affairs ministry's official refugee-guidance note on sexual orientation, gender identity and expression (v2.0, June 2025, updated Aug 2026): treats LGBT+ people as a particular social group under the refugee convention; same-sex conduct is not criminalised but same-sex marriage and gender transition are banned; trans people, publicly active LGBT+ advocates and people in one restive region of the country face treatment amounting to persecution; no region-specific exceptions apply to this state/province (guidance is nationwide).

An international human-rights organisation's report (30 June 2025) on the rising toll of LGBT 'extremism' designations: courts in this country issued 101 extremism convictions for alleged participation in the banned 'international LGBT movement' or its symbols - about 98 administrative misdemeanour cases and 3 criminal; the designation was made by the top court in 2023 and entered into force in January 2024; documented nationwide via court websites, with no regional concentration noted for this state/province.
